text:
Gus: Datadog wants a hands-on lab for partners showing OTLP ingestion + lightweight dashboard. Can we make a 10-min lab?
Lina: yes. keep it: 1) k8s install, 2) tiny app that emits model spans, 3) import dashboard JSON.
Tom: i'll do the k8s daemonset and a systemd service example for onprem. snippet for daemonset:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: otel-agent
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: otel
        image: otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest
        env:
        - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
          value: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
        - name: DD_API_KEY
          value: "<redacted>"
```
Hannah: add a one-liner about keys and KMS: for Private installs note how to inject DD key via customer KMS/HSM.
Gus: also include a small JSON that maps our trace fields to dd tags for the lab: `{"model_id":"model","model_version":"version","request_id":"req"}`. show sampling tip: only sample request_id at 1%.
Datadog-bot: endpoint-check: OTLP reachable from lab cluster - PASS
Lina: timeline: I'll assemble lab repo by Thu EOD, demo run Wed 3pm. Tom will add systemd example and export script. Hannah will draft marketplace blurb and legal embargo note.
Tom: systemd snippet for onprem forwarder: `ExecStart=/usr/bin/otelcol --config /etc/otel/config.yaml`
Gus: perfect. will create calendar for Wed run and ping SIs for feedback. :thumbsup:
